```json
 "topology": "NMOS common-source with PMOS current-source load (replica-sized mirror bias)",
 "rationale": "GBW≥270MHz into 0.5pF needs gm≈1.1mS, so I1≈88uA at vgs=0.75V (gm/Id≈13). Power budget: 10uA iref + 5uA bias branch + 88uA ≈ 185uW. The gain must sit in a 45–54 V/V window to satisfy both f3db and GBW, so it is set by gds through moderate L. M1 width is solved so Id1(0.75V, vds=0.9) equals the actual mirrored load current, which centres vout. Swing is about 1.8−vdsat_n−vdsat_p, roughly 1.3V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (88e-6, 60e-6, 95e-6),   # main branch current
    "Ln":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),        # input device L (sets gds_n)
    "Lp":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),         # PMOS load / diode L
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 6.0, 13.0),        # PMOS load gm/Id
    "Lm":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # NMOS bias mirror L
    "gmid_m": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),       # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id
    "k":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # bias branch ratio Ibranch/iref
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vout_t = 0.9

    # NMOS reference diode on ibias and mirror feeding the PMOS diode
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["Lm"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["Lm"], iref, vds=m6.vgs)
    W5 = m6.W * p["k"]

    # PMOS diode (current ~ k*iref)
    I5_nom = iref * p["k"]
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I5_nom, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I5_nom, vds=m3.vgs)
    vgs_p = m3.vgs
    # actual M5 current with its real vds (= VDD - vsg_p)
    I5a = lut.op("n", W5, p["Lm"], m6.vgs, VDD - vgs_p)["Id"]
    # rescale diode for the actual current (same gm/Id, so vgs is unchanged)
    W3 = m3.W * I5a / I5_nom

    # PMOS load: mirror ratio to reach I1, then actual current at vds = VDD - vout_t
    W2 = W3 * p["I1"] / I5a
    op2 = lut.op("p", W2, p["Lp"], vgs_p, VDD - vout_t)
    I2 = op2["Id"]

    # Input NMOS: solve W so that Id(vgs=vin, vds=vout_t) = I2
    W1 = 10.0
    for _ in range(4):
        Id_t = lut.op("n", W1, p["Ln"], vin, vout_t)["Id"]
        W1 = W1 * I2 / max(Id_t, 1e-12)
    W1 = min(max(W1, 0.42), 5000)
    op1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["Ln"], vin, vout_t)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M6", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", m6.W, p["Lm"])
    n.M("M5", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, p["Lm"])
    n.M("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W3, p["Lp"])
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, p["Lp"])
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["Ln"])

    gm = op1["gm"]
    gds = op1["gds"] + op2["gds"]
    A = gm / gds
    cout = cl * 1.08   # load capacitance plus junction/overlap parasitics
    gbw = gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    f3 = gds / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = VDD * (iref + I5a + I2)
    swing = VDD - op1["vdsat"] - op2["vdsat"] - 0.15
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": swing}
```
